note: Metrics that the dashboard and the alerts may name besides the ones monitoring/statsd/mapping.yml produces. Each entry says who emits it, so the check can tell a typo from a metric nothing sends.

prometheus.emitted_by: Prometheus itself, scraped as the prometheus job

statsd_exporter.emitted_by: the StatsD exporter itself, scraped as the statsd_exporter job

hai_api.emitted_by: the model API, scraped as the hai_api job on 127.0.0.1:8000. The API does not exist yet: it must expose these names and labels, or the contract here changes.
